message.content:
This vertical rectangular image is a magazine cover. A black-and-white close-up of a light-skinned man dominates the frame. He is in profile, facing right, with his mouth wide open. His right hand is raised to his chin, with his index finger touching his lower lip. He has dark, short hair, and his skin shows wrinkles around the eyes and forehead. He wears a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt with a collar. Behind him, another person’s face is blurred in the background.

The magazine’s title, "TEMPO," is at the top in large, white, serif capital letters. Above it, text in smaller black capital letters reads: "CATATAN DAGING PEJABAT BEA-CUKAI" and "MAJU-MUNDUR SUBSIDI ELPIJI," separated by a vertical line. Below the title is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." In the bottom left corner, black text reads: "Terdakwa perkara rasuah KTP elektronik Setya Novanto di Pengadilan Tindak Pidana Korupsi Jakarta, Rabu, 13 Desember 2017." In the bottom right corner are a date range "18-24 DESEMBER 2017," a price, a website, and a barcode with the number "9 770126 427302." A solid red vertical bar borders the left side.
